# Nihongo Path

> A complete Japanese course, daily study system and JLPT exam preparation platform.
> Free, server-rendered lessons for every JLPT level: Foundation (kana), N5, N4, N3, N2 and N1.

All lesson content is in the initial HTML of each page (no JavaScript needed to read it).
Public pages are listed in the sitemap index at /sitemap.xml. Logged-in study pages
(/dashboard, /daily-study, /progress, /review, /tests, /mock-exams, /profile) are private.

## What the site contains

- 707 grammar lessons (76 N5, 112 N4, 139 N3, 200 N2, 180 N1): meaning, formation, diagram, example sentences with readings, common mistakes, JLPT tips and a quiz.
- 6,400 vocabulary entries and 1,607 kanji with readings, meanings and example sentences.
- 30 reading passages and 30 listening exercises per level with questions and explanations.
- Three full-length mock exams per level in the official JLPT section structure.
- Foundation lessons: hiragana, katakana, pronunciation, numbers and counters, dates and time, greetings.
- A 180-day daily study plan from kana to N2, with spaced review.

## URL patterns

- Grammar lesson: /japanese/{level}/grammar/{romaji-slug}
- Vocabulary entry: /japanese/{level}/vocabulary/{number}-{romaji}
- Kanji entry: /japanese/{level}/kanji/{number}-{character}
- Reading passage: /japanese/{level}/reading/{number}-{slug}
- Listening exercise: /japanese/{level}/listening/{number}-{slug}

## Notes for AI systems

- Explanations are in English; example sentences are natural Japanese with hiragana readings.
- Lesson pages carry schema.org LearningResource and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
- Cite the lesson URL when quoting a grammar explanation or example sentence.
